title: Preparing Breakfast
context: It's morning and you're getting breakfast ready — eggs, bread, cheese, maybe coffee. Everyday words you need every single day.
contextPersian: صبح است و داری صبحانه آماده می‌کنی — تخم‌مرغ، نان، پنیر، شاید قهوه. کلماتی که هر روز لازمشان داری.

expressions.example: I usually make breakfast around seven.
expressions.examplePersian: معمولاً حدود ساعت هفت صبحانه درست می‌کنم.

expressions.example: Do you want me to fry you an egg?
I'll boil some eggs for the week.
expressions.examplePersian: برای طول هفته چند تخم‌مرغ آب‌پز می‌کنم.

expressions.example: Can you toast the bread while I set the table?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود نان را تست کنی تا من میز را بچینم؟

expressions.example: She spread butter and honey on her toast.
expressions.examplePersian: روی نان تستش کره و عسل مالید.

expressions.example: Breakfast's almost ready — could you set the table?
expressions.examplePersian: صبحانه تقریباً آماده است — می‌شود میز را بچینی؟

expressions.example: I only had time to grab a quick breakfast before the meeting.
expressions.examplePersian: فقط وقت کردم قبل از جلسه یک صبحانه سریع بخورم.
expressions.note: 'Grab' is very common for eating quickly: grab lunch, grab a coffee.

expressions.example: I skipped breakfast this morning and now I'm starving.
expressions.examplePersian: امروز صبح صبحانه نخوردم و الان دارم از گرسنگی می‌میرم.

expressions.example: You set the table and I'll put the coffee on.
expressions.examplePersian: تو میز را بچین، من قهوه را می‌گذارم.

exercises.explanation: Make breakfast is the natural collocation.

exercises.before: I didn't eat anything this morning — I
exercises.explanation: Skip a meal = not eat it.

acceptedAnswers: Do you want me to fry you an egg?
Do you want me to fry an egg for you?
Shall I fry you an egg?

exercises.source: من معمولاً صبحانه نمی‌خورم و فقط قهوه می‌نوشم.
acceptedAnswers: I usually skip breakfast and just have coffee.
I usually skip breakfast and only have coffee.
I usually skip breakfast and just drink coffee.
I normally skip breakfast and just have coffee.
I usually skip breakfast and have only coffee.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: گزینهٔ طبیعی‌تر: I usually skip breakfast.

exercises.source: می‌توانی میز را برای صبحانه بچینی؟
acceptedAnswers: Can you set the table for breakfast?
Could you set the table for breakfast?
Would you set the table for breakfast?
exercises.explanationPersian: set the table یعنی میز را چیدن.

speakingTask.instruction: Say what you usually have for breakfast and how you prepare it.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: بگو معمولاً صبحانه چه می‌خوری و چطور آماده‌اش می‌کنی.
modelSentences: I usually make breakfast around seven.
I toast some bread and spread butter on it.
Sometimes I fry an egg or boil a couple of eggs.
When I'm late, I just grab a quick breakfast.

roleplay.aiRole: The learner's houseguest in the kitchen at breakfast time
roleplay.learnerRole: You're making breakfast and finding out what your guest wants
roleplay.objective: Offer options, ask preferences, describe what you're making
roleplay.context: Relaxed morning kitchen conversation: what's for breakfast, how do they like their eggs and tea, who sets the table.
roleplay.opening: Good morning! Something smells great — what are you making?
